notes.title: Progress Update - Wish Gameplay
notes.content:
HI everyone!  

We've been hard at work improving the core experience of Stream or Die! - specifically the entire Wish gameplay loop.  It's fresh and cool and much more interactive - no stressful multitasking or real-time time limits.

Your gameplay to explore the world, delve, dungeons, and slay those massive Monumentals will be at your pace, but when battle begins the real-time conflicts will be even more intense, tactical, and unique.  

For story fans - don't worry - the story itself is complete - 25 endings and the ride along the way is unlike anything you've experienced!

The launch of Stream or Die! has to be pushed back for this refined core gameplay experience. 
Trust me, it will be worth the wait.

Thanks to everyone for your patience and support—stay tuned for more news!
